text:
Kai: heads-up  we've had a couple incidents where trace compaction made billing and forensic analysis messy. want a short canonical playbook: deterministic attribution + minimal SDK contract + emergency runbook.
Zara: agreed. we should make compaction auditable and reversible when possible. list of must-haves?
Kai: my draft list: (1) compact modes and deterministic cohort ids, (2) compact_audit event shape, (3) SDK advisory surface and best-effort trimming rules, (4) rehydration delta protocol for late enrichment, (5) ops predicates + admin API, (6) runbook for bursts.
Micah: for cohort id let's use a stable namespace: cohort_id = sha256(tenant|route|policy_hash|minute_bucket). avoids randomness and lets us join events later.
Tess: compact modes should be explicit: KEEP_FULL, SKELETON, TOMBSTONE (write a tombstone marker only), TRIM (remove low-value attrs). operators should be able to map routes to default mode.
Kai: compact_audit must be emitted whenever mode != KEEP_FULL. audit must contain cohort_id, tenant, route, mode, tokens_saved_estimate, policy_id, and timestamp. prefer machine-friendly field names.
Zara: example audit line (single-line JSON in the log stream) example: {"cohort_id":"sha256:...","tenant":"acct-9","route":"/v1/complete","mode":"SKELETON","tokens_saved":5234,"policy_id":"telemetry_v3"} -- we will put that inside the text blob for the playbook.
Micah: SDK advisory API: telemetry.advice({urgency:'ok'|'warn'|'shed',actions:['trim_attrs'|'drop_spans'|'pause_enrich'],ttl_s:60}). SDKs follow recommendation best-effort; server still final authority. keep it small.
Tess: rehydration: when delayed enrichment arrives, we write a rehydrate_patch referencing cohort_id and any resolved orig_ids. emit rehydrate_delta event with tokens_used and attribution_map to allow billing to pick up where compaction left off.
Kai: key for billing: if compact_audit lacks orig_ids we attribute to compaction_reserve until a rehydrate_delta provides attribution_map. compaction_reserve is a temporary bucket tagged by policy_id for reconciliation.
Zara: ops admin API sketch: POST /admin/telemetry/policies -> payload includes scope, policy_id, soft_pct, hard_pct, priority_cutoffs, default_mode, token_quota_window_s. keep schema small and auditable.
Micah: predicate engine should evaluate simple expressions authored by ops: e.g. "when cpu_pct>75 and queue_ms>200 -> mode=SKELETON for priority>=200". no Turing-complete expressions; evaluate in a sandbox.
Tess: monitoring hooks: metrics.telemetry.compaction.count, .tokens_saved_total, .cohort_rehydrations, per-tenant compaction_rate, and an error counter for rehydrate_failures. also add a daily job to reconcile compaction_reserve with billing.
Kai: short incident runbook: 
- T0: flip policy to aggressive mode via admin API (decrease soft_pct threshold)
- T1: enable SKELETON for non-critical routes with predicate toggle
- T2: if still degraded, enable TOMBSTONE for experimental prefixes and notify PagerDuty
- Post-incident: run cohort reconciliation within 72h and publish cost delta to finance.
Zara: next steps: Micah prototypes compact_audit + rehydrate_delta schemas and a tiny simulator, Tess will draft the 1-pager playbook with examples, Kai will coordinate gate and oncall comms. meeting Fri 11am to finalise.
billing-bot: notice: billing pipeline v6.7 scheduled maintenance tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
Micah: will fold maintenance window into simulator. I'll open a PR for schema tonight.
Kai: thanks everyone 44d will share the 1-pager in #eng-docs once Tess posts it.
